family_reports.body: I spent years trying to protect my family, only to watch prolonged litigation drain our finances, destroy our stability, and leave us homeless. My daughter has special needs, and the system that should have helped us instead made it harder to keep her safe, housed, and connected to the services she needs.
My children send me videos daily crying. They think they don’t get to ever come home.
Has kept my family apart for 11 months this

public_comments.comment_text: I believe the litigation strategy prioritized continued conflict over timely resolution. The prolonged proceedings consumed resources that could have been used to support my daughter’s care, treatment, housing, and stability. My daughter has special needs and depends on consistent services and routine. The ongoing litigation contributed to disruption, instability, and hardship during a critical period of her development. Repeatedly litigated custody issues while domestic violence issues remained unresolved. Positions taken during the case contributed to prolonged proceedings, escalating legal expenses exceeding $100,000, and significant delays in achieving stability for my child. Used delay tactics, and imposed costly mediations and proposals.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Refuses to listen to my children regardless of video evidence.
